name: optigrade
description: Sistema de otimizacao de oferta de disciplinas para a UFPel.

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/worker && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run python -m app.main
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @optigrade/web test && cd apps/api && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run pytest && cd ../../crates/optimizer && cargo test
scripts.seed: cd apps/api && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.migrate: cd apps/api && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run alembic upgrade head
